verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust/Axum web UI framework (scaffolding, components, rendering, islands). It has no automations or workflow concept, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Proa ships an automation capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
